method: AABB BVH broad phase over indexed triangles, followed by edge-segment vs opposing triangle Moller-Trumbore intersection checks in both directions. Geometry uses GLB world positions; nodes have identity transforms.

posteriorArmholeBand.definition: 0.14 < abs(x) < 0.46 m; 1.35 < y < 1.54 m; z < -0.03 m (posterior side in +Z-front coordinate system)

limitations: Pair counts include repeated triangle pairs across the same local contact region; they are not unique defect counts.
Edge-through-triangle checks detect non-coplanar crossings/contact; coplanar overlaps may not be detected.
This screen does not estimate penetration depth or collision severity. Visual evidence of exposed mannequin/open garment gaps is assessed separately.
